why: Dotted output names in the decorator now create the parent output plug if it is missing and register the named sub plug on it, so `outputs=["out.a", "out.b"]` gives an `out` plug with `out.a` and `out.b` sub plugs. `__call__` also keeps the sub plugs when it builds a new instance.

The change checks for duplicate IDs before modifying `_contents`/`_options`, so a failed `add_option` no longer leaves the duplicate behind to re-raise on every later refresh; it also keeps the in-use ID set in sync on remove and clear, so later additions work.
The change skips any requirements line that starts with '-', so pip option lines like `--find-links` no longer reach the parsing that crashed, and a test covers the example.

The change rejects the Greek mu 'μV' (U+03BC) with a ValueError instead of normalizing it to the micro sign 'µV' like 'uV', so the reported failing case still fails rather than working.
The change adds an async `open_async` to DirFileSystem that joins the path and awaits the underlying filesystem's `open_async`, which is exactly the delegation the request describes.

The diff only removes `Optional` from parameters with non-None defaults and never converts `bar: Type = None` to `Optional[Type] = None`, which is the main inconsistency the request says exists across the codebase.

The change replaces the early `return 1` with `status = 1; continue`, so every file in the batch is still checked and formatted, and the hook fails at the end through the existing `status` return when any file was invalid JSON.

For bytes input that starts with an XML declaration, the change now decodes the data using the declared encoding (or a detected one if none is declared) and strips the declaration before parsing, so the HTML parser gets correctly decoded text no matter how libxml2 2.12 handles the declaration.

The change registers a `collections.abc.Iterator` handler on `_parse_arg` that re-parses each element the iterator yields, so the generator from `pathlib.Path.glob` (as in the example) is accepted, and a test covers it.

A `get`/`set`/`deinit` token now starts a function only when a `{` follows; any other token (such as `=` in `case get = "GET"` or `let get = 1`) sends the parser back to the global state, so the enum case no longer swallows the rest of the file, and real accessors still parse.

The static pyproject path now tags each dependency with its extra and runs it through the existing recursive self-extra expansion, so a nested extra like `tests` -> `attrs[tests-no-zope]` resolves to the local metadata instead of PyPI.

MySQL index column lists are now parsed with `_parse_ordered` inside parentheses, which avoids the alias problem the reporter hit, and generated back as `(a DESC, b ASC)`; the reported example and multi-column variants now parse and round-trip, and the MySQL tests pass.

When `fill_value` is None (zarr v2), new partial chunks are now built with the dtype's default fill value instead of uninitialized memory, so the encoded bytes are deterministic; this assumes `_default_fill_value` is already imported in `codec_pipeline.py`, as the diff adds no import.
